description: NaTaO₃ is Orthorhombic Perovskite structured and crystallizes in the orthorhombic Cmcm space group. There are two inequivalent Na¹⁺ sites. In the first Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to six O²⁻ atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.38-2.74 Å. In the second Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded in a 10-coordinate geometry to ten O²⁻ atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.52-2.94 Å. Ta⁵⁺ is bonded to six O²⁻ atoms to form corner-sharing TaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 19-26°. All Ta-O bond lengths are 1.98 Å. There are three inequivalent O²⁻ sites. In the first O²⁻ site, O²⁻ is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na¹⁺ and two equivalent Ta⁵⁺ atoms. In the second O²⁻ site, O²⁻ is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na¹⁺ and two equivalent Ta⁵⁺ atoms. In the third O²⁻ site, O²⁻ is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na¹⁺ and two equivalent Ta⁵⁺ atoms.
